# Daniel Bailey

> Daniel Bailey is a writer, editor, interviewer, musician, and communications producer based in Madisonville, Louisiana. Some work is published under the byline Daniel O' Bailey.

This site is the official portfolio for Daniel Bailey. It features essays, reviews, interviews, fiction, editing and communications work, music, and ways to get in touch.

## Main site

- [Homepage](https://danielobailey.com/): Biography, selected work, services, music, and contact information.
- [Latest writing](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/): Essays, reviews, satire, interviews, and dispatches.
- [RSS feed](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/feed): Substack publication feed.

## Selected writing

- [The Curse of Lono, Reviewed from the City of Refuge](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/the-curse-of-lono-reviewed-from-the): Review of the Simon & Schuster reissue, including a contribution from Ralph Steadman's daughter.
- [My Uncle David and the Car That Tried to Kill Him](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/my-uncle-david-and-the-car-that-tried): True story set in Wilmer, Alabama.
- [I Am 29 and Peter Richardson Has Me By the Throat](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/i-am-29-and-peter-richardson-has): Essay on Hunter Thompson, Peter Richardson, and Scanlan's.
- [I Tried To Obey Every Self-Help Video In My Feed For One Day](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/i-tried-to-obey-every-self-help-video-e72): Satirical experiment.
- [GonzoFest Behind The Scenes #3](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/gonzofest-behind-the-scenes-3): GonzoFest dispatch.
- [The Cowpasture](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/the-cowpasture): Essay about a cow retrieval mission in Mississippi.
- [Behind the Scenes: GonzoFest #2](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/behind-the-scenes-gonzofest-2): Earlier GonzoFest dispatch.
- [GonzoFest Behind the Scenes](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/gonzofest-behind-the-scenes): Earlier GonzoFest dispatch.
- [disappear near me](https://danielbaileyoffical.substack.com/p/disappear-near-me): Essay on Substack.
- [I Tried To Obey Every Self-Help Video In My Feed For One Day](https://maudlinhouse.net/i-tried-to-obey-every-self-help-video-in-my-feed-for-one-day/): Published satire at Maudlin House.
- [disappear near me](https://www.bloodhoneylit.com/fiction/disappear-near-me): Fiction published by Blood+Honey.
